Whistleblowing Policy - How to report unethical
behaviour.
Stanbic is committed to establishing a culture of
integrity, transparency, openness and compliance, in
accordance with the values and Code of Ethics adopted
by Stanbic.
The Whistle‑blowing Policy provides for the protected
disclosure of any attempted, suspected or actual
and/or unlawful, irregular or unethical behaviour by
providing a framework for whistle‑blowers to report
their concerns internally or externally.
